transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today, and what would you like help with?

I’ve been eating really tiny amounts and skipping a lot of meals, and my weight keeps dropping. I know it’s not normal, but I still feel like I have to keep it low, and it’s starting to scare me a bit, so I want help getting this under control.
Do you feel very afraid of gaining weight or becoming fat, or feel that your body looks larger or different from what other people tell you they see?

Yeah, I’m really scared of gaining any weight, like even a small change on the scale makes me panic. I avoid certain foods because I’m convinced they’ll make me fat, and when I look in the mirror I still see my stomach and thighs as big even though people keep telling me I’m very thin.
Have you noticed any physical changes from the weight loss, like missed periods, feeling dizzy or faint, feeling cold all the time, or your heart racing or slowing down?
I’ve been feeling dizzy pretty often, especially when I stand up, and I’m cold a lot even when other people seem fine. My periods have also become really irregular and sometimes don’t come at all.

Do you ever have episodes where you feel out of control and eat a large amount of food at once, and if so, do you do anything afterwards to try to ‘undo’ it, like vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

I don’t really have episodes where I lose control and eat a lot; it’s more that I’m always trying to eat less. I don’t make myself vomit or use laxatives, and I don’t do extra exercise specifically to “make up” for what I’ve eaten.

There is no history of binge eating or compensatory behaviors, supporting anorexia nervosa, restricting type (F50.0) rather than bulimia nervosa or binge–purge type anorexia.
